info.title: WindFarmer Services API
info.description: A DNV WindFarmer calculation services API.

post.summary: Queues an energy calculation to be executed with the given inputs.

delete.summary: Cancels the running of a calculation for the given Id.

get.summary: Gets the status of an async AnnualEnergyProduction calculation.

404.description: No calculation exists with the given ID.

post.summary: Gets the energy calculation result for the given inputs.
Gets the blockage correction result for the given inputs.

get.summary: Checks the status of the API and validates authentication.

200.description: Returns Ok for successful status check.

get.summary:
Performs comprehensive site classification and returns atmospheric condition data
compatible with WindFarmer.Calculations.DataModel for flow modeling applications.
Includes atmospheric stability weights derived from ERA5 data and vertical profiles.

timeFromAsSunRiseOffset.description:
The start time of a daily time range specified as an offset from sunrise.
A +ve offset means after sunrise while a -ve means before sunrise.

timeToAsSunRiseOffset.description:
The end time of a daily time range specified as an offset from sunrise.
A +ve offset means after sunrise while a -ve means before sunrise.

timeFromAsSunSetOffset.description:
The start time of a daily time range specified as an offset from sunset.
A +ve offset means after sunset while a -ve means before sunset.

timeToAsSunSetOffset.description:
The end time of a daily time range specified as offset from sunset.
A +ve offset means after sunset while a -ve means before sunset.

startDayOfYear.description: The start day of year that the rule applies to, inclusive. Assumes non leap year.

endDayOfYear.description:
The end day of year that the rule applies to, inclusive. Assumes non leap year.
Note: if day 59 (28th of Feb) is specified, the calculation will interpret this as till the end of February
which means that if a time series has records on the 29th of Feb these be included in this interval.

inclusionOfNeighborsBufferZoneInMeters.description:
Inclusion buffer for neighboring wind farms to be included in estimating blockage for the subject farm; units: meters
Note: property only relevant when CalculateBlockage == true, and BlockageCorrectionApplicationMethod == OnWindSpeed.
      However, when BlockageApplicationMethod == OnWindSpeed, the inclusion buffer needs to be set explicitly (may be 0 if all neighbours are to be excluded).

blockageCorrectionApplicationMethod.description:
Setting to specify whether to apply blockage correction on wind speed or on energy. Default value: OnEnergy. 
Note: if includeBlockage == False this settings is ignored.

includeIntermediateResults.description: Gets or sets whether to include intermediate result data or not.

blockageCorrectionApplicationMethod.description:
Setting to specify whether to apply blockage correction on wind speed or on energy. Default value: OnEnergy. 
Note: if includeBlockage == False this settings is ignored.

beet.description: DNV BEET model settings. Can be omitted if BlockageModelType is not BEET.

cfdml.description: DNV CFD.ML model settings. Can be omitted if BlockageModelType is not CFD.ML.

calculateEfficiencies.description: If true, the energy calculation will be run several times so that the efficiencies can be calculated.

calculateIdealYield.description: If true, the ideal (reference) yield is calculated.

calculateSensitivityCurve.description: If true, wind speed perturbation to energy perturbation sensitivity curves are computed and returned in the results.

includeHysteresisEffect.description: If true, the high wind cut-out hysteresis effect will be included.

includeCurtailmentRules.description: If true, the turbine management rules will be applied.

turbineFlowAndPerformanceMatrixOutputSet.description: The output settings for the turbine flow and performance matrices.

numberOfDirectionSectorsForWakeCalculati.description: The number of direction sectors to use for the wake calculation. Units: -

maximumWindSpeedForEvaluation_m_per_s.description:
If this is non-zero then all flow cases up to this mast wind speed will be evaluated and reported
If this is zero, then flow cases will be evaluated for every wind-speed bin that has non-zero frequency of occurrence. Units: m/s

extrapolationAmbientTurbulence.description: The setting which defines whether to assume a constant std. dev. of wind speed or rather const. turbulence intensity.

airDensityCorrectionMethod.description: The method to use to extrapolate the power curve to the turbine location air density.

EnergyEfficienciesSettings.description: The Annual Energy Production (AEP) calculation settings.

windFarms.description: Wind farms to be included in the analysis.

turbineModels.description: Turbine models used in the wind farms.

windClimates.description:
The wind climate data provided as frequency and turbulence distributions. For use when this measured data exists.
If this list is specified then the List<WeibullWindClimate> EnergyCalculationInputs.WeibullWindClimates list should not be specified.

weibullWindClimates.description:
The wind climate data provided as weibull parameters for probabilities and a single turbulence value. For use when measured data is not available.
If this list is specified then the List<WindClimate> EnergyCalculationInputs.WindClimates list should not be specified.

atmosphericConditions.description: The atmospheric conditions that apply to existing wind climates.

referenceAirDensity.description: The reference air density for the wind farm.

EnergyCalculationInputs.description: A class for holding all the calculation inputs required for the energy calculation.

CalculationQueuedResult.description: Represents the result of queuing a job in OneCompute.

densityRotorDiameters.description: Gets the density rotor diameters (Internal use only).

blockageLossWs.description: Gets the blockage loss wind speed percentage (Internal use only).

hubHeightRotorDiameterMultiplier.description: Gets the hub height rotor diameter multiplier (Internal use only).

message.description: Gets or sets the response message.

windFarmerServicesAPIVersion.description: Gets or sets the WindFarmer services API assembly version.

calculationLibraryVersion.description: Gets or sets the calculation library version.

nearestEra5GridLongitude.description: Longitude of the nearest Era5 grid point

distanceToNearestGridPoint_km.description: Distance to the nearest Era5 grid point in kilometers

numberOfSectors.description: Number of directional sectors used in the analysis

coastlineDetectionRadius_km.description: Radius in kilometers used for coastline detection

era5TimeSeriesStartDate.description: Start date of the Era5 time series data

era5TimeSeriesEndDate.description: End date of the Era5 time series data
